coordinate.oracle: Independent packet mode decoder, integer geometry, residual-coordinate sequence and active-bit set replay.

mode.scope: Prepared full production states plus arbitrary initialized 2-bit memory, high32 ACTIVE_CLEAR indices; not arbitrary unreachable coordinate-state proof.

quant.oracle: Original packet bytes, integer run grammar, complete fill-address/value/remaining sequence; cache equality checked only on consumed Q_RUN branch.

scale.scope: Every valid1350-word location, four data values, full32 Q_FILL counter with valid low11 address; prepared states not packet reachability.
